# WebSocket script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## websocket.broadcast

Sends data to every app connected to Cuebot's WebSocket server, as a General.Custom event. Handy for your own overlays and tools.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `data` | What to send, like "{\"alert\": \"raid\"}" or plain text. |
| `json` | `json` | Optional. true reads data as JSON and sends it as an object (plain text if it is not valid JSON). Leave it out for false (send as text). |

**Gives back:** How many apps got it.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.broadcast", new { data = "{\"alert\": \"raid\"}", json = true });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_broadcast(data="{\"alert\": \"raid\"}", json=True)
    ```

## websocket.clientConnect

Connects one of your WebSocket clients (set up on the Servers page). Does nothing when it is already connected. Fails when no client matches.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.clientConnect", new { connection = "My overlay" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_client_connect(connection="My overlay")
    ```

## websocket.clientDisconnect

Disconnects one of your WebSocket clients. Fails when no client matches.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.clientDisconnect", new { connection = "My overlay" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_client_disconnect(connection="My overlay")
    ```

## websocket.clientIndex

Finds the number of a WebSocket client in the list on the Servers page, by its name.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `name` | The client's name, like "My overlay". |

**Gives back:** Its number (0 is the first), or -1 when no client has that name.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.clientIndex", new { name = "My overlay" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_client_index(name="My overlay")
    ```

## websocket.clientIsConnected

Checks whether one of your WebSocket clients is connected right now. Fails when no client matches.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |

**Gives back:** true when it is connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.clientIsConnected", new { connection = "My overlay" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_client_is_connected(connection="My overlay")
    ```

## websocket.clientSend

Sends a message through one of your WebSocket clients. Fails when no client matches.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which WebSocket client from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |
| `data` | `data` | What to send, like "hello". |

**Gives back:** true when it was sent, false when the client is not connected.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.clientSend", new { connection = "My overlay", data = "hello" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_client_send(connection="My overlay", data="hello")
    ```

## websocket.serverBroadcast

Sends a message to the apps connected to one of your custom WebSocket servers. Fails when the server is not running.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |
| `data` | `data` | What to send, like "hello". |
| `sessionId` | `session_id` | Optional. Send only to this one connection (its session id). Leave it out for everyone. |

**Gives back:** How many connections got it.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.serverBroadcast", new { connection = "Game server", data = "hello" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_server_broadcast(connection="Game server", data="hello")
    ```

## websocket.serverCloseAll

Disconnects every app connected to one of your custom WebSocket servers. The server keeps running.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |

**Gives back:** How many connections were closed (0 when the server is not running).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.serverCloseAll", new { connection = "Game server" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_server_close_all(connection="Game server")
    ```

## websocket.serverCloseSession

Disconnects one app from one of your custom WebSocket servers.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |
| `sessionId` | `session_id` | The session id of the connection to close, like the %sessionId% of a custom server trigger. |

**Gives back:** true when it was closed, false when there is no such connection or the server is not running.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.serverCloseSession", new { connection = "Game server", sessionId = "3f2a9c" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_server_close_session(connection="Game server", session_id="3f2a9c")
    ```

## websocket.serverStart

Starts one of your custom WebSocket servers, so other apps can connect. Fails when no server matches.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.serverStart", new { connection = "Game server" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_server_start(connection="Game server")
    ```

## websocket.serverStop

Stops one of your custom WebSocket servers. Connected apps are disconnected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` | `connection` | Which custom WebSocket server from the Servers page: its number in the list (0 is the first), its name or its id. Leave it out for 0. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("websocket.serverStop", new { connection = "Game server" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.websocket_server_stop(connection="Game server")
    ```
